summary: Destroy-and-free wrapper for a multi-list container. Unconditionally releases the list contents via MultiListFreeWithTraversal; when the object pointer a1 is non-null, finalizes it with EmptyStub_7470 and frees the object through FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns 0. Called from ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects during resource teardown.

operations.description: MultiListFreeWithTraversal(a1) walks and frees the multi-list embedded in a1
if a1 is non-null, finalize and free the owning object
EmptyStub_7470(a1) runs a stub finalizer on the object (effect unknown)

unresolved: EmptyStub_7470 is a stub routine; the finalization it performs is unknown.
The concrete object type behind a1 and the relationship between the list and the freed object are unknown.
Why the list is freed before the null check on a1 while the object is freed after it is unclear.
